questions: Can active-inference objectives produce compute-matched agents that equal strong model-based reinforcement-learning baselines on planning, adaptation, robustness, and efficiency?

direction.question: Can active-inference objectives produce compute-matched agents that equal strong model-based reinforcement-learning baselines on planning, adaptation, robustness, and efficiency?
direction.closureCriteria: Under identical observations, model capacity, environment steps, and tuning budgets, an active-inference agent matches or exceeds strong model-based baselines across several environment families, with objective ablations identifying where expected-free-energy terms add value.
partialResults: Deep active inference with Monte Carlo tree search plans in dSprites and Animal-AI environments.
Discrete active-inference agents and the maintained pymdp library establish reproducible small-scale feasibility.
starters: Individual: Implement a pymdp or neural active-inference agent on MiniGrid and compare it with PPO and a model-based baseline under fixed environment-step and tuning budgets.
Small lab: Run preregistered objective ablations across MiniGrid, Procgen, and selected DeepMind Control Suite tasks, measuring adaptation after dynamics and reward shifts.
Well-funded lab: Build a distributed active-inference agent and conduct a compute-matched simulation-to-robot evaluation with robustness, calibration, and wall-clock efficiency measurements.

noveltyReview.scope: arXiv titles and abstracts for active inference, expected free energy, robotics, planning, and reinforcement learning, plus modern control benchmarks and official implementations.
noveltyReview.note: Existing demonstrations are mainly small, simulated, or robotics-specific; the search did not establish priority or exhaust every venue.

counterexamples: Fountas et al. demonstrate a deep active-inference MCTS agent in continuous-state simulations.
Sajid et al. compare active inference with reinforcement learning in discrete Gym-style settings.
pymdp provides a maintained implementation for discrete Markov decision processes.
